route: Uneven timestamps make ordinary ACF invalid
steps: 1. Ordinary acf() assumes comparable elapsed-time lags; reject unequal intervals. ~ 2. Inspect a line_chart with actual timestamps. ~ 3. Resample with justified rules or use a method designed for uneven measurements.
